import cProfile, pstats, sys, io
src = open('/app/submission/main.py').read()
g = {'__name__':'m'}

    def __init__(self, b): self.buffer = io.BytesIO(b)

old = sys.stdin
sys.stdin = FakeIn(data)
out = io.StringIO()
oldout = sys.stdout
sys.stdout = out
pr = cProfile.Profile()
pr.enable()
g['main']()
pr.disable()

s = io.StringIO()

print(s.getvalue()[:2600])
